column4: walang structure,kahit saan goto statements, walang separation of concerns — mahirap i-follow ang flow
i-extract ang layers: UI → Controller → Service → Repository, i-dependency injection ang connections
walang initial design, quick fixes, copy-paste, walang code review — technical debt ang dulot
i-apply ang clean architecture, i-separate ang concerns, i-review ang code regularly
unti-unting pag-aayos habang nagta-traverse — huwag biglang baguhin lahat, i-improve lang ang parts
